title: Target Product Scraper
description: Extract product results from Target listing URLs or keywords with pagination and sorting controls.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Target listing URL. This URL is used when Keyword is empty. If both are provided, Keyword mode takes precedence and this URL is ignored. Defaults to a wireless headphones search when no search input is provided.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword used to collect products.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Number of Products
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to save.

include_sponsored.title: Include Sponsored Products
include_sponsored.description: Include sponsored products in the response.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for reliable data collection. A rotating US residential proxy is used by default to reduce blocks.
